title: The Clever Fox and the Crow
text:
Long ago, a fox lived in a big forest. One day, he was very hungry. He saw a crow in a tree. The crow had a piece of cheese in her beak.

The fox said, 'Your voice is so beautiful!' The crow was happy. She opened her mouth to sing. The cheese fell down, and the fox ran away with it. The crow learned a lesson.

questions.text: What did the crow have in her beak?
What did the fox say to the crow?
Why did the fox say nice things to the crow?
options: He wanted to learn to sing
He was the crow's best friend
He wanted to build a house

questions.text: What lesson did the crow probably learn?
options: Do not trust someone who is nice only to get something

vocabulary.definition: a large area with many trees
wanting to eat because you have not eaten for a long time
a food made from milk, often yellow or white
something you learn from an experience

paragraph_translations: Hace mucho tiempo, un zorro vivía en un gran bosque. Un día, tenía mucha hambre. Vio a un cuervo en un árbol. El cuervo tenía un trozo de queso en el pico.
El zorro dijo: '¡Tu voz es muy bonita!' El cuervo estaba feliz. Abrió el pico para cantar. El queso cayó, y el zorro se fue corriendo con él. El cuervo aprendió una lección.
